artifact.title: How Later SEC Comparatives Leak Into Historical Backtests: A CoreWeave Case Study
artifact.creator: AhaSignals

researchQuestion: What changes in a historical 2025 query when a warehouse silently overwrites first-reported values with comparatives accepted in 2026?

testDesign.contaminatedRule: Select the latest stored value without constraining SEC acceptance time to the historical decision time.
testDesign.pointInTimeRule: Select the latest source vintage with acceptedAt less than or equal to decisionTime.
testDesign.scope: Fourteen selected facts that have exact taxonomy, unit and period identity in both accessions. This is a data-integrity case study, not a portfolio-return backtest.

findings.conclusion: A warehouse that stores one value per fact identity cannot answer what was known in 2025. It returns 14 values from a filing accepted in 2026; four exceed the disclosed rounding gate and one reverses sign.

derivedEffects.label: Q2 2025 revenue
derivedEffects.interpretation: A destructive latest-value warehouse understates the revenue value available to the 2025 decision by $0.788 million.

derivedEffects.label: Other investing activities
derivedEffects.interpretation: The leaked comparative reverses the sign from a positive $26.109 million to a negative $6 million.

derivedEffects.label: Q2 2025 gross margin
derivedEffects.interpretation: Two small input changes alter the reconstructed historical margin even though the economic period is unchanged.

derivedEffects.label: H1 2025 operating cash flow less capital expenditure
derivedEffects.formula: operating cash flow − purchases of property and equipment
derivedEffects.interpretation: The derived cash-flow proxy shifts by $0.434 million when both historical inputs are silently replaced.

derivedEffects.label: H1 2025 stock-based compensation intensity
derivedEffects.interpretation: A ratio can change even when each source difference is individually compatible with lower display precision.

reproducibilityRules: Use SEC acceptance time as the public-availability clock.
Apply the as-of filter before calculating a feature.
Keep missing observations missing; do not convert them to zero.
Treat rounding-compatible, presentation-change and issuer-restatement classes separately.
limitations: The 14 facts are a reviewed subset with exact identity matches, not a reconstruction of every cell in either Form 10-Q.
The case study demonstrates source-vintage contamination; it does not measure realized portfolio returns, alpha, information coefficient, Sharpe ratio or drawdown.
A different comparative value is not automatically an error. The issuer did not label these differences as a restatement.
The first tradable daily decision time is a documented benchmark convention, not a claim about intraday dissemination latency.
Company names and ticker symbols identify source filers only. AhaSignals is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the issuer or the SEC.
